summary: Full backend + frontend testing for TeachHub new features (post types html/worksheet/blog, upload/files, folders, follow/subscribe, Studio /workspace, confirm-password + eye toggles). All 43 backend pytest tests pass (16 new + 27 existing regression). All 15 requested frontend flows pass on the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Object storage upload/download verified end-to-end with a real PNG. Follow counters live-update; Following feed populates after follow. Workspace 3-zone layout, folders CRUD, filters, task selection preview, pencil->edit, and fullscreen eye toggle all working.

issues: Description char counter reads '0/500' initially with a redundant hint — cosmetic only.
The 'eye' toggle uses the Eye icon (open eye) to enter fullscreen; UX-wise an ArrowsOut icon might be clearer, but a title tooltip is present.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py file is now ~770 lines and contains DB models, storage client, auth utils, serializers and every route in one module. Recommend splitting into routers/ (auth, tasks, files, folders, follows, admin) and services/ (storage, security). Not blocking, but will bite maintainability.
put_object/get_object make synchronous requests inside async handlers (blocks the event loop). Under load this will degrade throughput. Consider httpx.AsyncClient or run_in_threadpool.
task_public + enrich_cards do N+1 lookups for authors/likes/favorites. enrich_cards batches authors but task_public does per-request author fetch. Fine at current scale, worth batching later.
get_optional_user swallows all HTTPExceptions (including 500). Consider only catching 401.
seed_admin resets admin password on env drift silently — behaves as documented in playbook but log a warning for auditability.
delete_account: two separate delete_many on follows could be a single $or query.
test_credentials: admin@teachhub.com/admin12345, teacher@teachhub.com/teacher12345 (both verified). Throwaway accounts registered & deleted during test run.
seed_data_creation: Registered 2 throwaway users during UI test and deleted them at end. Created 3 tasks (TEST_HTMLpost/TEST_WSpost/TEST_BLOGpost) and cleaned them up. Backend pytest created & deleted its own TEST_* fixtures. No residual data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new features working. Feed type filter cards show badges via [data-testid=card-type-<id>] with human text ('Blog'/'Worksheet'/'Interactive'). ws-folder testids: 'ws-folder-all', 'ws-folder-type:<t>', 'ws-folder-subject:<s>', 'ws-folder-folder:<id>'. ws-fullscreen appears only in fullscreen mode; the eye toggle button retains same testid ws-eye-toggle in both states. Upload endpoint (POST /api/upload) requires Bearer auth; files served via GET /api/files/{id} publicly. When probing view-iframe / worksheet-content / blog-content visibility, always add a >1s wait after navigation because PostContent mounts after task fetch.
